usage: tr dataset publish [-h] --form {public,private} [--name NAME]
                          [--out DIR] [--split SPLIT_ID] [--teacher MODEL]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --form {public,private}
                        public: Alpaca prices and headlines as placeholders;
                        private: verbatim (personal use)
  --name NAME           file stem (default: teacher-sft)
  --out DIR             an empty or new directory (default: data-
                        dev/release/<name>)
  --split SPLIT_ID      default: the latest registered split
  --teacher MODEL       only this teacher's analyses (default: every pinned
                        teacher)
